scope: Bounded local model two-pass single-card review; not independent human approval.

cards.title: Competing Theories
cards.instruction: Create several explanations for what is happening. Test each new clue against them, and switch allegiance whenever one theory gains strength.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The missing cake is theft, accident, or the dog. Keep all three on the board.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's icing on the dog.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Dog moves into first place.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's icing on you too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then theft deserves renewed funding.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our wedding cake's gone: theft, accident, or the dog. I suspect theft.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's icing on him. Get him outside before Mum sees.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Dog leads. I'll take him; check under the table for crumbs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That icing's from yesterday. The crumbs lead into the cloakroom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Theft leads again. Keep the dog here; let's see whether that trail ends at a dropped cake or somebody's coat.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 offers three theories; A3 favours dog and A5 renews theft after different icing evidence.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's icing supports A3's dog theory; B4's icing on A supports A5's theft switch, though not uniquely.

relationship.evidence: B4 implicates A personally, preventing A from treating evidence as safely external.

heightening.evidence: A5 continues allocating support to theories even when B4 makes A a possible culprit.

specificity.evidence: A1's missing cake and B2/B4's visible icing are immediately playable evidence.

brevityWit.evidence: A5's 'renewed funding' extends A1's board language while accepting incriminating evidence.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 creates theft, accident and dog explanations; A3 switches to dog on B2's icing evidence, and A5 returns to theft after B4's correction.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 acts on B2's icing and requests crumbs; B4 dates the icing and supplies a trail, which A5 follows while retaining accident as a possibility.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants the dog removed before Mum sees; A3 cooperates, but B4's evidence makes A5 reverse that practical decision and recruit B to investigate.

heightening.evidence: A5 reverses the dog-removal plan and proposes checking coats, but the stakes and commitment increase only slightly beyond A3's crumb search.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a missing wedding cake; B2 adds Mum's impending reaction, and B4 supplies a playable trail into the cloakroom.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'Dog leads' and A5's 'Theft leads again' efficiently express shifting allegiance, with the dog's changing instructions providing a small comic consequence.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2's icing evidence promotes the dog theory, while the request to remove the dog produces A3's agreement to take him.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 discredits the icing and redirects the search to the cloakroom; A5 changes allegiance, reverses the dog's removal and tests the trail's destination.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A1 establishes competing explanations; both subsequent A turns explicitly revise their ranking against B's evidence.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 makes another theory switch alter practical instructions and opens a more targeted test, though the escalation is modest.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A maintains rival explanations and shifts support as each new clue changes their relative strength.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Serial accusation replaces one suspect with another without testing explanations; A explicitly retains competing theories.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: A1 says to keep all three theories, while A3 ranks dog and A5 reopens theft.

records.recommendedEdit: Kept the wedding setting and removed the candidate's solved hiding scheme and champagne extension. Separate internal reread: fidelity 5, A1 supplies three explanations, A3 backs dog and A5 restores theft while explicitly testing accident; logic 4, B2's icing prompts A3's search and B4's older icing plus crumb trail prompts A5's new test, though theft's lead remains provisional; relationship 4, B2 wants discretion before Mum sees and A5 changes B's job to containing the dog during investigation; heightening 4, A5 turns a preferred explanation into a search distinguishing two surviving theories; specificity 5, A1/B4 establish wedding cake and a trail into the cloakroom; wit 4, A3/A5's shifting allegiance repeatedly redirects the same dog-handling task. Total 87. Five spoken turns, 63 words; original firstPass preserved. No pair dialogue or seed provenance changed.
records.remainingConcern: Narrow internal pass. A5's preference for theft is provisional rather than strongly proven, and heightening is modest; its proposed test nevertheless keeps both theft and accident active. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: A cloakroom trail supports movement without proving theft, so A5 must sound provisionally convinced and still willing to test accident. B can resist keeping the dog inside. The S144 bespoke binding remains incompatible for its existing provenance reasons; model review only.
records.alternativeComparison: The preserved lights alternative uses cooperative repair and a safety discovery to revise causal responsibility. This candidate makes theory changes interfere with managing a dog during wedding preparations.

cards.title: Competing Theories
cards.instruction: Create several explanations for what is happening. Test each new clue against them, and switch allegiance whenever one theory gains strength.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The lights failed because of weather, wiring, or the caretaker's shortcut.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's sunny.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Weather withdraws gracefully.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The caretaker unplugged them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Shortcut wins. Wiring can keep its dignity.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The hall lights failed: weather, wiring, or the caretaker saving electricity. Wiring's my favourite.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He unplugged them. Help me reach the socket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Economy takes the lead. I'll hold your ladder.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The socket's wet. There's rain coming through the roof.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Weather overtakes him. Leave the plug; let's ask whether he unplugged it before the leak.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 supplies three explanations and A3/A5 eliminate them, but only A5 clearly chooses an allegiance.

responseLogic.evidence: A3 uses B2's sunshine; A5 uses B4's unplugging, although unplugging does not establish a shortcut motive.

relationship.evidence: B2 and B4 dispense answers without a practical want or changing tactic.

heightening.evidence: A5 announces the answer already supplied in B4 rather than developing the competing-theory behaviour.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes failed lights but no occasion, location, or urgency.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's graceful withdrawal and A5's dignity are concise, but mostly decorate elimination.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 prefers wiring among three theories; A3 switches to economy; A5 switches to weather and asks a discriminating question.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's unplugging changes A3's theory and action; B4's rain changes A5's theory and cancels reconnecting.

relationship.evidence: B2 wants help reaching the socket, giving A3 a useful supporting role before B4 changes the task.

heightening.evidence: A5 makes theory revision consequential by stopping the plug attempt and investigating the caretaker's timing.

specificity.evidence: A1 locates failed hall lights; B2 supplies the socket, A3 the ladder, and B4 the roof leak.

brevityWit.evidence: A3's 'takes the lead' and A5's 'overtakes' keep the competing-theory voice while advancing the repair.

hardGateEvidence.b2CausesA3: B2 reports deliberate unplugging and requests assistance; A3 backs economy and offers ladder support.
hardGateEvidence.b4CausesA5: B4 discovers rain at the socket; A5 backs weather, stops reconnection and questions the unplugging sequence.
hardGateEvidence.cardContribution: A's changing allegiance determines both practical cooperation and the next evidence question.
hardGateEvidence.sameGameHeightened: A5 moves from naming a leading theory to testing whether the caretaker was responding to the leak.

mechanismDistinction.mechanism: A lets new clues transfer allegiance among several live explanations and determine the next inquiry.
mechanismDistinction.confusableConcept: Simple elimination reaches an answer once; this stance remains willing to reorder previously considered explanations.
mechanismDistinction.distinguishingEvidenceRequired: Original A1 names three explanations, with A3 withdrawing weather and A5 selecting the caretaker's shortcut.

records.recommendedEdit: Specified a hall and repair partnership. Internal reread 5/5/4/4/5/4 = 92: B2 displaces wiring in A3; B4 revives weather and changes A5's proposed action and timing question.
records.remainingConcern: The ranking language is slightly stylized, but the practical interaction supports it. No rewrite needed.
records.writerReservation: Weather and wiring can coexist causally; A is ranking explanations, not demonstrating that they are mutually exclusive.
records.alternativeComparison: B is an active collaborator facing a changing repair problem, unlike the cake alternative's mostly evidentiary role.
